description:
Perform a security header compliance audit for https://crawler-test.com/. 

1. Open Screaming Frog SEO Spider and enter 'https://crawler-test.com/' in the URL bar. Ensure you are crawling the HTTPS version.
2. Start the crawl and wait for it to complete.
3. Navigate to the 'Security' tab to analyze HTTP response headers.
4. Export the Security tab data (showing all URLs and their header status) to a CSV file named 'security_audit.csv' in '/home/ga/Documents/SEO/exports/'.
5. Analyze the data and write a summary report to '/home/ga/Documents/SEO/reports/security_headers_summary.txt'. The report must include:
   - Total number of URLs crawled.
   - Count of URLs missing 'X-Frame-Options'.
   - Count of URLs missing 'X-Content-Type-Options'.
   - A statement on whether HSTS is enforced (Yes/No).

NOTE: The export must be generated from the Security tab, not the Internal tab.
